acceptanceCriteria: One real Beamfall change is completed through the docs/DOGFOOD.md daily path with the installed Corvint binary, and a `beamfall-dogfood` receipt (profile corvint-use-case-evidence/0) is retained for each of UC-TASK-ORIENTATION, UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE and UC-EVIDENCE-CARRYING-COMPLETION, pinned to the Beamfall commit and the Corvint revision.
The ledger validator accepts the receipts and the ledger rows record them.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 by decision 0373 item 16 (V1-0011 stays open; the three Core ledger rows are `experimental`, every claim UNPROVEN). No `beamfall-dogfood` evidence class exists for any Core row, and `verified` needs all six classes (contract, implementation, hostile-tests, corvint-dogfood, beamfall-dogfood, sealed-benchmark). This is owner-run work on the Beamfall repository; the receipt must not be produced from Corvint's own tree.
title: conformance: retain a `beamfall-dogfood` receipt for the three Core use cases from the daily path on Beamfall
